label: map005_175012bf
speaker: char_ulric
en: Good to know we're on the same page.\nIt'd be foolish to try taking them on alone.
zh: se/z00014.ogg

label: map005_73cf90b7
speaker: char_ulric
en: You must be mistaken. This wasn't an option.\nI can't keep an eye on both of you in the heat of battle.\nValessa has her daggers, and you need something as well.
zh: se/z00028.ogg

label: map037_488b746d
speaker: Narration
en: More suits of armor litter the ground, there's so many of them.{w}\nIt makes me feel a bit hopeful, like we stood a chance.{w}\nThe village wasn't defenseless, and this was proof.
zh: 地上散落着更多盔甲，数量多得惊人。{w}\n这让我稍稍燃起希望，仿佛我们还有胜算。{w}\n村子并非毫无防备，这就是明证。

label: map037_96442f7f
speaker: Narration
en: He stares at me with a serious look on his face.{w}\nTalk about putting me on the spot.{w}\nBut if this was my role, I had to fill the shoes.
zh: 他一脸严肃地盯着我。{w}\n真是把我架在火上烤。{w}\n可如果这就是我的角色，我就必须担起来。

label: map037_6a115fbc
speaker: char_ulric
en: Good to know we're on the same page.\nMylus can't be the only one with information.
zh: 很高兴我们想法一致。\n掌握情报的人不可能只有迈勒斯一个。

label: map037_2d80f2de
speaker: char_valessa
en: Good, we're on the same page.\nWe can use that information to help others.\nIt would be selfish to focus only on Valinorth.
zh: 很好，我们想到一块儿去了。\n我们可以用这些情报去帮助其他人。\n只盯着瓦利诺斯，那就太自私了。

label: Valessa2_map085_1_0_2048b12d
speaker: char_valessa
en: I'd want to get to the bottom of it, then.\nThere's more going on than we can take at face value.\nHe'd have his reasons, and I'd want to hear all of them.
zh: 那我就想把事情查个水落石出。\n这里面另有隐情，不能只看表面。\n他一定有自己的理由，而我想全部听他说清楚。

label: Valessa2_map084_6_0_2048b12d
speaker: char_valessa
en: I'd want to get to the bottom of it, then.\nThere's more going on than we can take at face value.\nHe'd have his reasons, and I'd want to hear all of them.
zh: 那我就想把事情查个水落石出。\n这里面另有隐情，不能只看表面。\n他一定有自己的理由，而我想全部听他说清楚。

label: click_map084_53_EV053_23f9dfc1
speaker: Narration
en: I crawl under the table, it's full of useless trinkets.{w}\nWhatever we were looking for, I doubt it's down here.
zh: 我爬到桌子底下，满是没用的零碎玩意儿。{w}\n不管我们在找什么，我怀疑它不在下面。

label: click_map084_53_EV053_291d5a81
speaker: Narration
en: I get out from under the table, after Ulric's verbal lashing.{w}\nHe might've disagreed, but we had to search everywhere we could.
zh: 在挨了乌尔里克一顿训之后，我从桌子底下钻了出来。{w}\n他也许不赞同，但我们得把所有能搜的地方都搜一遍。

label: map043_81e4b12e
speaker: char_fortaime
en: Hey, I'm just trying to be nice!\nI didn't mean to steal your thunder.\nAfter all, this day is all about {i}you{/i}!
zh: se/z00208.ogg

label: click_map078_12_EV012_514a67cd
speaker: Narration
en: I really wish I could just hop back into bed.{w}\nBut I guess I have responsibilities and stuff.{w}\nI shouldn't keep Mylus in the dark for much longer.
zh: 我真希望能直接跳回床上。{w}\n可我想我还有责任在身之类的。{w}\n我不该再瞒着迈勒斯太久了。

label: Fortaime2_map078_166_1_bd5ff25b
speaker: char_fortaime
en: It's pretty great, actually.\nEverything is given to me by Valinorth.\nMoney, food, a house. You name it.
zh: se/y00122.ogg

label: map008_d5aa7e76
speaker: Narration
en: She points to a man standing near my house.{w}\nHe has his back against it, and taps his foot on the ground.{w}\nI guess he knew where I lived. Mylus must've told him.
zh: 她指着一个站在我家附近的男人。{w}\n他背靠着墙，脚尖点着地。{w}\n看来他知道我住哪儿。一定是迈勒斯告诉他的。

label: map008_630b49cb
speaker: char_fortaime
en: So you know what's coming, right?\nI just need to make sure we're on the same page.
zh: 所以你知道要发生什么，对吧？\n我只是得确认我们想法一致。

label: map047_07becb3b
speaker: char_valessa
en: Thanks. I appreciate it — I truly do.\nIt's always good when someone has your back.\nVenting helps, as inconvenient as it's known to be.
zh: 谢谢，我很感激——是真心的。\n有人挺你，总是好事。\n发泄一下是有用的，尽管大家都知道那不太得体。

label: map047_1442e7b6
speaker: char_valessa
en: Good. I'm glad we're on the same page.\nYou know what they say about dire times, right?\nLet's make sure this stays between the two of us.
zh: 好。很高兴我们想法一致。\n你知道人们怎么说艰难时局的，对吧？\n这事就只留在你我之间。

label: map062_77c941db
speaker: Narration
en: She looks a bit startled at the sudden demand, but slowly steps forward.{w}\nI can sense her apprehension at being put on the spot. I know that feeling.
zh: 这突如其来的要求让她有些吃惊，但她还是慢慢走上前。{w}\n我能感到她被当众点名的忐忑。那种感觉我懂。

label: map062_f1857bb2
speaker: Narration
en: He looks a bit startled at the sudden demand, but slowly steps forward.{w}\nI can sense his apprehension at being put on the spot. I know that feeling.
zh: 这突如其来的要求让他有些吃惊，但他还是慢慢走上前。{w}\n我能感到他被当众点名的忐忑。那种感觉我懂。

label: map062_5ba1aa95
speaker: Narration
en: I can tell that Valessa is getting annoyed. I've never seen her like this.{w}\nAs if to offer assistance, Ulric steps forward, clearing his throat.{w}\nPerfect timing too, as Valessa was about to lose her temper.
zh: 看得出瓦莱莎开始恼火了。我从没见过她这样。{w}\n仿佛是要出手相助，乌尔里克清了清嗓子，走上前来。{w}\n时机也恰到好处，瓦莱莎正要发脾气。

label: map062_d24d75e4
speaker: Narration
en: I can tell that Fortaime is getting annoyed. I've never seen him like this.{w}\nAs if to offer assitance, Ulric steps forward, clearing his throat.{w}\nPerfect timing too, as Fortaime was about to lose his temper.
zh: 看得出福泰姆开始恼火了。我从没见过他这样。{w}\n仿佛是要出手相助，乌尔里克清了清嗓子，走上前来。{w}\n时机也恰到好处，福泰姆正要发脾气。

label: map053_d8bfe36a
speaker: char_ulric
en: Case in point, Pro.
zh: 这就是活生生的例子，普洛。

label: map053_95e7269d
speaker: char_ulric
en: People from Valinorth would never harm Mazeo, true.\nBut that's what makes it the perfect excuse for wrongdoers.\nSay you're from Valinorth, and get through without a second thought.
zh: 瓦利诺斯的人确实绝不会伤害马泽奥。\n但正因如此，它才成了坏人最完美的借口。\n说一句你来自瓦利诺斯，就能毫无阻碍地通过。

label: Ulric4_map054_9_0_1c04bba0
speaker: char_ulric
en: There are two pirate lords, Alex and Nada.\nThey see eye to eye on most things, but disagree on others.\nStill, rather than fight each other, they've come to rule together.
zh: 有两位海盗头目，亚历克斯和娜达。\n他们在多数事情上看法一致，但也有分歧。\n不过他们没有彼此争斗，而是选择了共同统治。

label: Ulric5_map054_9_0_8c10f2f8
speaker: char_ulric
en: I've never had to think about it, so I don't really have an answer.\nBut I'd probably have to go with Alex. Nada is a bit too ruthless for me.\nIf she was in power, people would be under her thumb — rather than free.
zh: 我从没想过这个问题，所以真没什么答案。\n不过大概我会选亚历克斯。娜达对我来说太狠了些。\n要是她掌权，人们就都得受她摆布——而不是自由。

label: map067_63bfb5c4
speaker: char_fortaime
en: You know, when I climb trees, it's hard to get a grip.\nBut with these, I can just stab them into the tree and hold on.\nI didn't know these existed. It would make things {i}so{/i} much easier!
zh: 你知道，我爬树的时候很难抓稳。\n但有了这些，我只要把它们扎进树里就能攀住。\n我都不知道还有这种东西。这会让事情{i}轻松{/i}太多了！

label: map068_1df08ba7
speaker: char_pro
en: Good, I'm glad.\nYou caught me, so I had to come clean.\nOtherwise, I would've kept this stuff secret.
zh: 很好，我很高兴。\n你逮到我了，所以我只好坦白。\n不然的话，我会把这事一直瞒着。

label: map070_c549cda2
speaker: char_ulric
en: It's time for you to tell us what's going on.\nI hate being left in the dark like this. You know that.
zh: 该你告诉我们到底怎么回事了。\n我讨厌像这样被蒙在鼓里。你知道的。

label: click_map074_146_EV146_5a20b9ae
speaker: char_jit_map071_1_0_50
en: Alex. Hands down.
zh: 亚历克斯。毫无疑问。

label: click_map124_9_EV009_d11a38d8
speaker: char_jit_map008_1_0_111
en: Imagine if food was scarce.\nThere'd be a lot more people breaking the law.\nStealing it, hurting others for it, you name it.
zh: se/w00053.ogg

label: click_map124_13_EV013_6a7d4f31
speaker: char_valessa
en: Even with a head start, you're no match for me.\nTime to throw in the towel. Stick to climbing trees.
zh: 就算让你先跑，你也不是我的对手。\n认输吧。你还是去爬树吧。

label: click_map124_20_EV020_b0010c84
speaker: char_pro
en: Good. We can't have any moles.\nThe Rebellion, as it is — currently hangs on threads.\nIt's only thanks to that anomalous blade that we stand a chance.
zh: 很好。我们不能有内奸。\n反抗军如今——正悬于一线。\n全靠那把异常的剑，我们才有机会。

label: click_map124_32_EV032_00fbc820
speaker: char_jit_map124_32_1_17
en: Alex. Hands down.
zh: 亚历克斯。毫无疑问。

label: click_map127_27_EV027_17b718bc
speaker: char_pro
en: They have to watch {i}every{/i} direction; and constantly be ready.\nIt serves to show us how strong they {i}truly{/i} are. It's crazy.\nDraycu is undefeated, but Ulric might just stand a chance.
zh: se/w00344.ogg

label: click_map127_29_EV029_696eecb5
speaker: char_damek
en: In that case, maybe I do side with Vivien.\nWith Ulric's strength, he may stand a chance.\nI hope [firstname] is on the same page as us.
zh: 既然如此，也许我确实站在薇薇安这边。\n以乌尔里克的力量，或许有一拼之力。\n希望[firstname]和我们想法一致。

label: click_map127_29_EV029_696eecb5
speaker: char_damek
en: In that case, maybe I do side with Vivien.\nWith Ulric's strength, he may stand a chance.\nI hope [firstname] is on the same page as us.
zh: 既然如此，也许我确实站在薇薇安这边。\n以乌尔里克的力量，或许有一拼之力。\n希望[firstname]和我们想法一致。

label: click_map127_37_EV037_7e509fc2
speaker: char_pro
en: Of course. All according to plan.\nI know Ulric is mad, but he'll get over it.\nWe can win this without either of us dying.
zh: 当然。一切都在计划之中。\n我知道乌尔里克很生气，但他会消气的。\n我们可以不必让任何一方送命就赢下这场。

label: click_map127_41_EV041_f65e794a
speaker: char_fortaime
en: Yeah, same! That's my main goal in all of this.\nWe're all a team, so we need to help each other out.\nI'll have your back as long as you have mine, Valessa.
zh: 是啊，我也是！这就是我做这一切的主要目标。\n我们都是一个团队的，就该互相帮助。\n只要你支持我，我就会支持你，瓦莱莎。

label: map133_6ebe36b7
speaker: char_fortaime
en: Good. I'm glad we're all on the same page.\nIt's something we can talk about more as a group.\nValessa feels the same way, she just wouldn't speak up.
zh: se/y00939.ogg

label: map133_372b5f43
speaker: char_fortaime
en: Understandable. You're on the fence.\nIt's something we can talk about more as a group.\nValessa believes they're trapped in there. I know it.
zh: se/y00942.ogg

label: map130_14266d83
speaker: char_pro
en: I mean, I had to come clean about being a swindler, right?\nI'd rather do it right out of the gate than surprise you later on.\nWe can get to know each other more, now, and see if we click.
zh: se/y01005.ogg

label: map136_f2b3cbfa
speaker: Narration
en: A few moments later, an army of pirates floods in from the tunnels.{w}\nSovy, Halin and Shane quickly become defensive, trying to fend them off.{w}\nThere was enough now that they stood a chance. Their targets were clear.
zh: 片刻之后，一支海盗大军从隧道涌了进来。{w}\n索维、哈林和肖恩立刻转入守势，试图抵挡。{w}\n如今人数够了，他们有了胜算。目标也很明确。

label: map138_906ed789
speaker: char_fortaime
en: Yeah. We wouldn't have stood a chance in combat.\nI don't know why they wanted to help, but they did.
zh: se/z01268.ogg

label: map142_c8198ed8
speaker: char_damek
en: Driven by the howls of countless spirits, he seeks vengeance.\nBut he has also brought with him the answers to our every question.\nNo longer, shall we live in the dark. We know the {i}true{/i} nature of things.
zh: se/z01410.ogg

label: map142_65ba4398
speaker: Narration
en: I look at the rebels, and hold the blade up in the air.{w}\nThe beams of light from the surface serve to illuminate its beauty.{w}\nThis elicits rigorous applause from the rebels, as they cheer me on.
zh: 我看向反抗军们，把刀刃高举在空中。{w}\n从地面透下的光束照亮了它的华美。{w}\n这引来了反抗军们热烈的掌声，他们为我欢呼。

label: map145_4f32b386
speaker: Narration
en: I can tell that they're about to get locked in a heated argument.{w}\nTo avoid this, I slam my hands down on the war table, startling them.{w}\nA loud echo reverberates through the room as I assert my authority.
zh: 我看得出他们即将陷入激烈的争吵。{w}\n为了避免这一幕，我双手猛拍作战桌，把他们吓了一跳。{w}\n一声巨响在房间里回荡，我借此确立了自己的权威。

label: map146_8829bc22
speaker: char_damek
en: But now? Everything is different.\nI guess I'll take a step back for the time being.\nMaybe this is a blessing in disguise, you know?
zh: se/z01541.ogg

label: map239_1a96703a
speaker: char_pro
en: As far as I know, it's just my Dad.\nI think my Mom was under the weather or something.\nBut at this point, I'll take whatever I can get. I'm so excited...!
zh: se/y02033.ogg

label: map239_1a96703a
speaker: char_pro
en: As far as I know, it's just my Dad.\nI think my Mom was under the weather or something.\nBut at this point, I'll take whatever I can get. I'm so excited...!
zh: se/y02033.ogg

label: map239_070dc1c0
speaker: Narration
en: I awaken a while later, unsure of the time.{w}\nBut it's dark — it must be the dead of night.{w}\nPro snores softly, with his head resting on my shoulder.
zh: 不知过了多久，我醒了过来，分不清时辰。{w}\n但天已经黑了——一定是深夜。{w}\n普洛轻轻打着鼾，头靠在我的肩上。

label: map239_0754e567
speaker: Narration
en: I awaken a while later, unsure of the time.{w}\nBut it's dark — it must be the dead of night.{w}\nPro rests beside me, snoring softly. Asleep.
zh: 不知过了多久，我醒了过来，分不清时辰。{w}\n但天已经黑了——一定是深夜。{w}\n普洛躺在我身旁，轻轻打着鼾。睡着了。

label: map239_f34d55a5
speaker: Narration
en: It was cruel to schedule a meeting and then not follow through.{w}\nHis Dad must've gotten cold feet. Or maybe his Mother needed attention.{w}\n\"Under the weather\" could have any number of meanings. Not many of them good.
zh: 约好了见面却又不来，这太残忍了。{w}\n他父亲一定是临阵退缩了。又或者他母亲需要人照顾。{w}\n“身体不舒服”可以有很多种解释。多数都不太好。

label: map242_6616f904
speaker: char_howl
en: But when we look at it this way, everything makes sense.\nEverything has an explanation, and nothing is left up in the air.\nThe only question is — do you believe us? Do you think we are correct?
zh: se/y02132.ogg

label: map242_a973a301
speaker: Narration
en: He turns to leave, but tilts his head back to address me one more time.{w}\nI guess he wanted to leave no stone unturned before our attack on Balteus.
zh: 他转身要走，却又回过头来，再一次对我开口。{w}\n我猜，他想在进攻巴尔泰乌斯之前把事情彻查清楚，不留死角。

label: map252_3c5bcfe1
speaker: Narration
en: We exchange hugs and pleasantries for a few moments.{w}\nAre they really happy? Or are they just putting on an act?{w}\nIt's hard to tell — since this is the calm before the storm.
zh: 我们拥抱寒暄了一阵。{w}\n他们是真的开心吗？还是只是在演戏？{w}\n很难分辨——毕竟这是暴风雨前的平静。

label: map252_3c5bcfe1_1
speaker: Narration
en: We exchange hugs and pleasantries for a few moments.{w}\nAre they really happy? Or are they just putting on an act?{w}\nIt's hard to tell — since this is the calm before the storm.
zh: 我们拥抱寒暄了一阵。{w}\n他们是真的开心吗？还是只是在演戏？{w}\n很难分辨——毕竟这是暴风雨前的平静。

label: map252_1e2696aa
speaker: Narration
en: Either way, it's best to make the most of any happy moments.{w}\nThis was the calm before the storm. One final storm.
zh: 无论如何，都该尽情享受任何快乐的时刻。{w}\n这是暴风雨前的平静。最后一场暴风雨。

label: map253_bc90d853
speaker: char_pro
en: I'm just doing my best to hang in there...\nThis whole \"life at sea\" thing really isn't my style.\nI can't wait to get back and settle down for good.
zh: 我只是在尽力撑着……\n这种“海上生活”实在不合我的性子。\n我迫不及待想回去，彻底安顿下来。

label: map254_101133ee
speaker: char_damek
en: We should arrive in Balteus just as the sun is rising.\nWhen we do — we'll all be meeting at a central location for one final meeting.\nIt's important that everybody is on the same page before we take any big steps.
zh: se/z02262.ogg

label: map270_6299febf
speaker: char_pro
en: Sounds like a piece of cake, to be honest.\nConsider that castle empty upon your arrival!\nCausing distractions is totally a specialty of mine.
zh: 说实话，听起来小菜一碟。\n你就当到的时候城堡已经空了吧！\n制造混乱可是我的拿手好戏。

label: map280_70ef74cd
speaker: Narration
en: That's true. Nobody else has ever gotten this far.{w}\nI can tell that we stand a chance at winning, and it feels amazing.{w}\nBut I have to ask, how do we know that this Algus can be trusted?
zh: 没错。从没有别人走到这一步。{w}\n我能感觉到我们有机会赢，那感觉太棒了。{w}\n但我不得不问，我们怎么知道这个阿尔古斯可以信任？

label: map295_e5fd8be9
speaker: Narration
en: Even after his instruction, nobody makes a move.{w}\nThe ash in the air thickens — remnants of The Monarchy showering over them.{w}\nDamek takes a few steps forward, and holds his sword up in the air.
zh: 即便他下了指示，仍无人行动。{w}\n空气中的灰烬更浓了——王朝的残烬如雨般洒落在他们身上。{w}\n达梅克向前走了几步，把剑高举在空中。

label: map295_e918d343
speaker: Narration
en: The soldiers cheer, holding their swords up in the air as well.{w}\nBut soon after, they fall back down — resting in a fighting position.{w}\nDamek says nothing, simply holding his sword toward the enemy.
zh: 士兵们欢呼着，也把剑高举在空中。{w}\n但很快，剑又落下——摆出战斗的架势。{w}\n达梅克没有作声，只是把剑指向敌人。

label: map296_00edcb42
speaker: char_sovy
en: We're pressed for time, so I won't draw this out any longer.\nJust know that I'll have your back in there, as I'm sure you'll have mine.\nIf we make it through this unscathed, I'll know it was a team effort.
zh: se/sovy38.ogg

label: map300_80aab09f
speaker: char_pro
en: Yeah — plenty of times.\nIt'll be a piece of cake. Trust me.
zh: se/pro69.ogg

label: map304_b6dde4a2
speaker: char_halin
en: And who says {i}you{/i} get to call the shots?\nRemember, I exist to manifest The Triumvirate's will.\nAnd right now — what they want — is to see you all dead.
zh: se/z02804.ogg

label: Tri1_map308_1_0_cc263c90
speaker: char_the_triumvirate
en: Doing so would liberate the universe from this eternal war.\nBut we did not hold the power required to destroy the idol. Not yet.\nIf we could make the blade stronger, though, then we might stand a chance.
zh: se/z02940.ogg

label: map324_ebbad2b6
speaker: Narration
en: Sovy's past crimes were pardoned after his exceptional performance in Balteus.\nHis defection from The Triumvirate, and his advice regarding them were seen as invaluable.\nWere it not for his actions, and his change of heart — the war would've been lost.
zh: 索维在巴尔泰乌斯的卓越表现，使他的旧罪得到赦免。\n他脱离三人执政团，以及关于他们的建言，被视为无价之宝。\n若非他的行动与幡然醒悟——这场战争早已失败。

label: map324_c77f027d
speaker: Narration
en: Sovy's past crimes were pardoned posthumously, and he was labeled as a hero.\nHis defection from The Triumvirate, and his advice regarding them were seen as invaluable.\nWere it not for his actions, and his change of heart, the war would've been lost.
zh: 索维的旧罪在他身后得到赦免，他被冠以英雄之名。\n他脱离三人执政团，以及关于他们的建言，被视为无价之宝。\n若非他的行动与幡然醒悟，这场战争早已失败。

label: map326_52989f27
speaker: Narration
en: But not current history. He wrote about The Old Monarchy, and their ways.\nIt was almost as if the spirits inside of him felt regret at their actions.\nNobody knew why Howl had this change of heart — but it was for the better.
zh: se/z03125.ogg

label: map335_50b02c3b
speaker: Narration
en: After his passing, a grand tournament was held, and anybody was capable of entering.\nBecause nobody challenged Draycu, the nation would have to start with a clean slate.\nA new ruler emerged, and Alarinthia stayed largely the same for the rest of history.
zh: se/z03161.ogg

label: map340_c2113a9f
speaker: char_valessa
en: I'll admit, I was starting to worry as well.\nSorry if you were scared when we parted ways earlier.\nBut thanks to those daggers, they didn't stand a chance.
zh: 我承认，我也开始担心了。\n之前我们分开的时候，要是让你害怕了，我很抱歉。\n但多亏了那些匕首，他们根本不堪一击。

label: map340_74555940
speaker: char_fortaime
en: But it won't be all bad, right...?\nI mean, we'll have your back the entire time.
zh: se/z03194.ogg

label: map283_45e8435a
speaker: char_valessa
en: I'm pretty confident after hearing Damek's plan.\nI get to follow you to the castle too, so that makes me happy.\nYou can trust me to have your back if anything bad happens.
zh: se/z02501.ogg

label: map286_602f9fbc
speaker: char_pro
en: It's a lonely life, being a writer. It really is.\nYou pour so much emotion into it, that you almost run out.\nEveryone thinks you're giving them the cold shoulder, but you're not.
zh: se/pro28.ogg

label: map286_894d7e82
speaker: Narration
en: That would be easy. He's already done a lot to help us.{w}\nHe was responsible for our Alarinthian alliance, hands down.{w}\nHe's done his best to atone, and in my opinion, he succeeded.
zh: 那很容易。他已经帮了我们很多。{w}\n毫无疑问，阿拉林西亚的联盟正是他促成的。{w}\n他已尽力赎罪，在我看来，他成功了。

label: map285_04f14af6
speaker: char_ulric
en: Alright. As long as we're both on the same page.\nI expect the same from you. Don't hold back in any way.\nIf I'm in danger, don't stop to help me. You have your goal.
zh: se/z02577.ogg

label: map285_bccb2852
speaker: char_ulric
en: But when it comes to you, I know that my strength and honor {i}aren't{/i} misguided.\nYou can trust me to have your back, in the final battle, and beyond. I promise.\nFor once, I've found a cause I'd be happy to both live, {i}and{/i} die for.
zh: se/z02597.ogg

label: map288_b3786f45
speaker: char_howl
en: But, we must say — it was a battle that we lost fair and square.\nWe were so focused on our own future, that we lost sight of everyone else's.\nIt doesn't surprise us, that our \"perfect\" future came at the expense of others.
zh: se/z02640.ogg

label: map289_a0eda9f2
speaker: char_sovy
en: It might be best to just forget The Monarchy ever existed.\nStart over, from scratch, under the banner of The Rebellion.\nWhy reclaim a world for someone who would be your enemy?
zh: se/sovy22.ogg

label: map179_4182b7b8
speaker: char_jit_map179_1_0_78
en: He heard your group talking about a Rebellion, and a big army.\nThat's when I knew we hit the jackpot. Our new target was clear.\nBut to know you came here just for me? That's pretty flattering.
zh: se/z01776.ogg

label: click_map180_62_EV062_17b718bc
speaker: char_pro
en: They have to watch {i}every{/i} direction; and constantly be ready.\nIt serves to show us how strong they {i}truly{/i} are. It's crazy.\nDraycu is undefeated, but Ulric might just stand a chance.
zh: se/w00344.ogg

label: click_map180_63_EV063_696eecb5
speaker: char_damek
en: In that case, maybe I do side with Vivien.\nWith Ulric's strength, he may stand a chance.\nI hope [firstname] is on the same page as us.
zh: 那样的话，也许我确实该站在薇薇安这边。\n有乌尔里克的实力，他或许还有机会。\n我希望[firstname]和我们想法一致。

label: click_map180_63_EV063_696eecb5
speaker: char_damek
en: In that case, maybe I do side with Vivien.\nWith Ulric's strength, he may stand a chance.\nI hope [firstname] is on the same page as us.
zh: 那样的话，也许我确实该站在薇薇安这边。\n有乌尔里克的实力，他或许还有机会。\n我希望[firstname]和我们想法一致。

label: map204_ac5dc872
speaker: char_the_triumvirate
en: But you failed to retrieve it, {i}and{/i} let The Seer get away.\nAny silver lining you can come up with is simply not enough.\nDamek's death will only fuel them with rage to use against us.
zh: 可你没能夺回它，{i}还{/i}放走了先知。\n你能找出的任何一丝转机都远远不够。\n达梅克的死只会激起他们的怒火，用来对付我们。

label: map204_1d30536d
speaker: char_the_triumvirate
en: But you failed to retrieve it, {i}and{/i} let The Seeress get away.\nAny silver lining you can come up with is simply not enough.\nDamek's death will only fuel them with rage to use against us.
zh: 可你没能夺回它，{i}还{/i}放走了先知。\n你能找出的任何一丝转机都远远不够。\n达梅克的死只会激起他们的怒火，用来对付我们。

label: map205_96a76c62
speaker: char_ulric
en: I saw them take an impressionable young man, and ruin him.\nTurn him into a tool meant to kill without a second thought.\nThey took my friend, and after that, he was no more.
zh: se/y01349.ogg

label: Fortaime1_map190_11_0_bcb395b3
speaker: char_fortaime
en: I feel so bad for him. He always spoke about changing Alarinthia.\nBut when he's given the chance, his comrades side against him?\nHe must feel so lonely right now. Only Vivien's army has his back.
zh: se/y01395.ogg

label: click_map192_63_EV063_7e509fc2
speaker: char_pro
en: Of course. All according to plan.\nI know Ulric is mad, but he'll get over it.\nWe can win this without either of us dying.
zh: 当然。一切都在计划之中。\n我知道乌尔里克很生气，但他会消气的。\n我们可以赢下这一场，谁都不用死。

label: map208_0acea8b3
speaker: char_valessa
en: I know that pirates get involved in shady things, but they embraced it.\nKilling, stealing, smuggling, you name it. They were {i}legends{/i} in Mazeo.\nThey had a whole network operating for them while they were back home.
zh: se/y01441.ogg

label: map213_bc1d3244
speaker: char_jit_map213_1_0_12
en: Look. The way I see it, we're friends here.\nIf you need a ferryman back, I'd love to help you out.\nTreat me with the cold shoulder, and you could get stranded.
zh: se/x00447.ogg

label: map213_f970b24d
speaker: char_jit_map213_1_0_12
en: Lied to by your bosses? Join the club.\nThey'll do anything to save face and get their way.\nThat's part of why I work on my own, now. I get you.
zh: se/x00458.ogg

label: map213_56878756
speaker: char_jit_map213_1_0_12
en: There's no need to go that far.\nDon't misunderstand me. I've got your back.\nYou're not the only man who's run away, you know.
zh: se/x00469.ogg

label: click_map199_5_EV005_f65e794a
speaker: char_fortaime
en: Yeah, same! That's my main goal in all of this.\nWe're all a team, so we need to help each other out.\nI'll have your back as long as you have mine, Valessa.
zh: 是啊，我也是！这就是我做这一切的主要目标。\n我们是一个团队，所以要互相扶持。\n只要你挺我，我就挺你，瓦莱莎。

label: click_map199_16_EV016_07d34e77
speaker: char_howl
en: After the battle ends, the flame dwindles, and turns to ash.\nA clean slate for the victor — that is what this symbolizes.
zh: se/a00335.ogg

label: map212_417a804e
speaker: char_howl
en: Because you may follow after them without even knowing it.\nFor now, that is all we have to say. There are no other concerns.\nNext time we talk, perhaps more will have come to light. At least, we hope.
zh: se/y01476.ogg

label: map200_8bdc05e0
speaker: char_pro
en: We wouldn't stand a chance if we attacked Balteus on our own.\nAn alliance is necessary, and this is the best way we can get it.\nOne life — taken here today — is worth it, to change all of Alestia.
zh: se/z01924.ogg

label: map214_9719a272
speaker: char_pro
en: I knew we'd be able to push through this.\nThe fact that you sided with Draycu convinced me.\nEven in all the confusion, we still see eye to eye.
zh: 我就知道我们能挺过这一关。\n你站在德雷库那边这件事让我确信了。\n即便在一切混乱之中，我们依然心意相通。

label: map203_500e2ae9
speaker: char_jit_map203_1_0_195
en: So, it's finally going to happen.\nI've been dreaming about this day for a long time.\nDo your best out there, Monarch. I've got your back.
zh: 那么，终于要开始了。\n我梦想这一天已经很久了。\n在外面尽力而为吧，君主。我会罩着你的。

label: map203_c3b7547e
speaker: char_jit_map203_1_0_195
en: Of course, I {i}have{/i} heard rumors about that blade you're carrying.\nSo if you don't mind — I might choose to lean on you for support, too.\nIf we all take care of each other, then we'll be unstoppable for sure.
zh: se/z01951.ogg

label: map217_4119c447
speaker: Narration
en: Gripping the blade tightly, I try and figure out how to “activate” it.{w}\nAs if sensing my instinct, the gear on the base starts to spin fervently.{w}\nI raise it up in the air, and demand that the blade assist us in battle.
zh: 我紧紧握住剑刃，试图弄明白该如何“激活”它。{w}\n仿佛感应到我的意念，剑柄底部的齿轮开始疯狂转动。{w}\n我将它高举空中，命令剑刃在战斗中助我们一臂之力。

label: map220_a6baad4a
speaker: char_fortaime
en: Come on, [firstname].\nYou have my back in this, right?\nWhat happened was {i}way{/i} out of line.
zh: se/z02033.ogg

label: map220_a4d8ca0b
speaker: char_fortaime
en: Good. Then that means we're on the same page.\nIt's just so hard because of how close we are.
zh: se/z02036b.ogg

label: map223_3834232a
speaker: Narration
en: With everything we just gained? We actually stand a chance at winning this war...
zh: 有了我们刚刚得到的一切？我们真的有机会赢得这场战争了……

label: map224_f2825e5b
speaker: Narration
en: If I ever got the chance to talk to The Triumvirate, I'd ask them.{w}\nBut something tells me, if we're face to face, it won't be civil.{w}\nAnd for all I know, it's just a trick. The idol could be a red herring.
zh: 要是我有机会跟三人执政团谈谈，我会问问他们。{w}\n但直觉告诉我，真到了面对面的时候，可不会是什么文明的对话。{w}\n而且说不定这根本就是个圈套。那座灵像也许只是障眼法。

label: map225_6ca0f110
speaker: char_pro
en: Look — I made up for what I did...!\nAll those lives we lost? We got them back, and more!\nOur Alarinthian allies will help us win this war. Hands down.
zh: se/z02177.ogg

label: map168_b57785d6
speaker: char_halin
en: Through no fault of our own, remember?\nI have your back in this. I won't tell them the truth.\nHowever, I need to ask for {i}one{/i} thing in exchange.
zh: 那不是我们的错，记得吗？\n这件事我支持你。我不会告诉他们真相。\n不过，作为交换，我要求{i}一{/i}件事。

label: Fortaime1_map162_5_0_c1f7ce4e
speaker: char_fortaime
en: Whoa, putting me on the spot, huh?\nI guess I'd probably side with Vivien.\nUlric hates this place, and I can see why.
zh: se/y01147.ogg

label: Valessa1_map164_138_0_6ee5058d
speaker: char_valessa
en: Vivien, hands down. I don't like the way Alarinthia is run.\nRelying on strength alone creates such a toxic atmosphere.\nAnyone with a brilliant mind would simply be pushed aside.
zh: se/y01305.ogg

label: map076_9ff13a6b
speaker: char_jit_map076_1_0_93
en: Special, huh...?\nWell, that's all you had to say.\nYou know I've got your back in {i}everything{/i}.
zh: 特别，是吧……？\n嗯，你早这么说不就行了。\n你知道{i}任何事{/i}我都挺你。

label: Valessa1_map110_1_0_3129f6fe
speaker: char_pro
en: Whoa, you sure like putting me on the spot.\nI think you're cool? I mean, from what I've seen.\nAt first, I didn't really have a clue. But it's better now.
zh: se/y00853.ogg

label: map114_61a83f17
speaker: char_jit_map114_1_0_11
en: Destiny...?\nI'm not sure I buy into that stuff.\nI'd rather call the shots myself, you know.
zh: 宿命……？\n我不太信这套。\n我更愿意自己做主，你知道的。

label: map173_62f08ca3
speaker: Narration
en: He puts the climbing gear back in the bag, clearly excited.{w}\nIt's a breath of fresh air to hear him talk about this stuff so passionately.{w}\nEverybody else is so concerned about the war. It's nice to just push that aside.
zh: 他把攀爬装备放回包里，显然很兴奋。{w}\n听他这么充满热情地聊这些，真是耳目一新。{w}\n其他人都那么担心战争。能把这些搁到一边真好。

label: map173_62f08ca3
speaker: Narration
en: He puts the climbing gear back in the bag, clearly excited.{w}\nIt's a breath of fresh air to hear him talk about this stuff so passionately.{w}\nEverybody else is so concerned about the war. It's nice to just push that aside.
zh: 他把攀爬装备放回包里，显然很兴奋。{w}\n听他这么充满热情地聊这些，真是耳目一新。{w}\n其他人都那么担心战争。能把这些搁到一边真好。

label: click_map012_9_EV009_d11a38d8
speaker: char_jit_map008_1_0_111
en: Imagine if food was scarce.\nThere'd be a lot more people breaking the law.\nStealing it, hurting others for it, you name it.
zh: se/w00053.ogg

label: map027_7195cb06
speaker: char_halin
en: I guess you're right.\nBut I don't like being left in the dark.
zh: 你说得大概没错。\n但我不喜欢被蒙在鼓里。

label: click_map014_7_EV007_6a7d4f31
speaker: char_valessa
en: Even with a head start, you're no match for me.\nTime to throw in the towel. Stick to climbing trees.
zh: 就算抢跑，你也不是我的对手。\n认输吧。还是专心爬树去吧。

label: map022_48233380
speaker: Narration
en: I feel like, even though we barely talked, we're on the same page.{w}\nHe seems to know why we're here, where we're going, and what we need to do.{w}\nThat makes things a bit easier. Endless planning would be tedious.
zh: 我觉得，尽管我们几乎没说过话，却很有默契。{w}\n他似乎知道我们为什么来、要去哪里、需要做什么。{w}\n这让事情简单了些。无休止的盘算会很乏味。

label: click_map015_37_EV037_2321e564
speaker: Narration
en: I'm assuming in the dark, this helps people find Peregrino.{w}\nHowever, right now, it seems to serve no real purpose.{w}\nTo come here during the day, you'd have to know exactly where it was.
zh: 我猜在黑暗中，这东西能帮人找到佩雷格里诺。{w}\n不过眼下，它似乎没什么实际用处。{w}\n白天来这里，你得确切知道它在哪儿才行。

label: map023_8f6d25f4
speaker: Narration
en: Talk about putting me on the spot. I hope this isn't a frequent event.{w}\nI don't feel like this is my choice, but due to current circumstances — it is.{w}\nMylus resigned as The Elder, leaving me in charge until I elect a replacement.
zh: 真是把我架到火上烤。希望这不是常有的事。{w}\n我不觉得这是该由我做的选择，但眼下的情况——确实如此。{w}\n迈勒斯辞去了长老之位，在我选出继任者之前，由我掌管。

label: click_map016_8_EV008_b0010c84
speaker: char_pro
en: Good. We can't have any moles.\nThe Rebellion, as it is — currently hangs on threads.\nIt's only thanks to that anomalous blade that we stand a chance.
zh: 很好。我们不能有内鬼。\n反抗军如今——已是岌岌可危。\n全靠那把异常的剑我们才有一线希望。

label: click_map016_9_EV009_b0010c84
speaker: char_pro
en: Good. We can't have any moles.\nThe Rebellion, as it is — currently hangs on threads.\nIt's only thanks to that anomalous blade that we stand a chance.
zh: 很好。我们不能有内鬼。\n反抗军如今——已是岌岌可危。\n全靠那把异常的剑我们才有一线希望。

label: Pro6_map016_16_0_7aa57129
speaker: char_pro
en: Maybe I'll find someone special, and bring them along.\nThis is all up in the air, of course. A lot could change.\nI probably shouldn't plan it out. I'll play it by ear.
zh: se/y00607.ogg

label: Pro6_map016_16_0_7aa57129
speaker: char_pro
en: Maybe I'll find someone special, and bring them along.\nThis is all up in the air, of course. A lot could change.\nI probably shouldn't plan it out. I'll play it by ear.
zh: se/y00607.ogg

label: map024_8d39ea48
speaker: Narration
en: I rub the fatigue out of my eyes and stare at them for a few moments.{w}\nIt seemed that lately, people had a tendency of putting me on the spot.{w}\nTheir intentions were pure, however. To stop me from being overwhelmed.
zh: 我揉了揉疲惫的眼睛，盯着他们看了一会儿。{w}\n最近似乎人人都倾向于把我推到风口浪尖。{w}\n不过他们的用意是好的。是为了不让我被压垮。

label: Choices_map024_1_0_c91832e2
speaker: char_valessa
en: Yes! I knew we were on the same page!\nI can't thank you enough for this. Really.\nI was so scared that we'd lose Valinorth.
zh: 太好了！我就知道我们想法一致！\n真不知该怎么谢你。真的。\n我之前好怕我们会失去瓦利诺斯。

label: Choices_map024_1_0_7ab3a850
speaker: char_valessa
en: I'm sure I'll get over it, but I'm getting mixed signals.\nEither way, I'm proud to lead Valinorth just as you left it.\nI won't undo your decision. I respect it — I'll make it work.
zh: se/z00659.ogg

label: Choices_map024_1_0_ae522da2
speaker: char_valessa
en: I'm sure I'll get over it, but I'm getting mixed signals.\nEither way, I'm proud to lead Valinorth just as you left it.\nI won't undo your decision. I respect it — I'll make it work.
zh: se/z00661.ogg

label: Choices_map024_1_0_37d48a79
speaker: char_fortaime
en: Well, it seems like we have our work cut out for us.\nI'm a little upset that you didn't pick me, but I'll get over it.\nAt the end of the day, I'm not just \"tagging along\" anymore.
zh: 嗯，看来我们有的是活要干。\n你没选我，我有点难过，但我会释怀的。\n说到底，我不再只是“跟着凑数”了。

label: Valessa3_map088_177_1_ce6db71a
speaker: char_valessa
en: Isn't it a little late to be getting cold feet?\nWe've already been performing these duties forever.\nThis ceremony won't change much. It's just tradition.
zh: se/y00206.ogg

label: map092_0b9c3246
speaker: char_ulric
en: I expect it'll take me under a day.\nI'll arrive in the dead of night, or maybe early morning.\nSeeking out [firstname] will be the first thing I do.
zh: 我估计用不了一天。\n我会在深夜，或者清早到达。\n第一件事就是去找[firstname]。

label: map092_0b9c3246_1
speaker: char_ulric
en: I expect it'll take me under a day.\nI'll arrive in the dead of night, or maybe early morning.\nSeeking out [firstname] will be the first thing I do.
zh: 我估计用不了一天。\n我会在深夜，或者清早到达。\n第一件事就是去找[firstname]。

label: map092_fd85f638
speaker: char_damek
en: Fantastic, then things will go perfectly.\nMake sure to give the rest of the town a heads up.\nYou can all evacuate together. You'll blend right in.
zh: 太好了，那一切都会顺利。\n记得提前通知镇上的其他人。\n你们可以一起撤离。你会混在其中不显眼。

label: map092_6eece42b
speaker: char_damek
en: But remember, you need to stop by Mylus' and grab the blade.\nOtherwise, The Triumvirate will seize it when they attack.\nIf I'm honest, I don't think we stand a chance without it.
zh: se/x00007.ogg

label: map093_1439e54d
speaker: char_the_triumvirate
en: We would never do such a thing.\nInformation is granted to you as we see fit.\nIf you are left in the dark, it is not permanent.
